title: 3,000-year-old burial site discovered in El Salvador; archaeologists uncover human skull, remains and ancient sea turtle-shaped vessel
description: Archaeologists in El Salvador are investigating a remarkable discovery that could date back nearly 3,000 years, after an ancient pre-Hispanic burial site was uncovered in Antiguo Cuscatlan, a suburb of San Salvador. According to a news release from El Salvador’s Ministry of Culture, the burial site was discovered earlier this month, with excavation work beginning on July 21.

title: An ancient civilization of millions once flourished in the Amazon
description: New research conducted using airborne laser scanning reveals that a multicultural civilization that flourished in southwestern Amazonia between 600 BCE and 850 CE was home to millions of people. Spanning roughly 183,000 square kilometers (71,000 square miles), the Aquiry civilization built large centers for political and ritual purposes.

title: Ancient Persian-translated Quran unveiled at Iran National Library
description: TEHRAN- A high-quality facsimile edition of the "Zaferani Quran", recognized by scholars as the oldest known complete and dated manuscript of the Holy Quran accompanied by a Persian translation, was unveiled during a ceremony at the National Library and Archives of Iran on Tuesday.

title: ‘The fastest game on grass’: How the ancient Irish sport of hurling is thriving in Milwaukee
description: The Milwaukee Hurling Club was founded in 1996 and has around 240 members. Two of the original members told WPR about the sport and why this club has grown to be one of the largest outside of Ireland.
